items.heading: Kabuli Pulao
details: Key ingredients: basmati rice, lamb, carrots, raisins, cumin
Braise lamb pieces with onion until tender, reserving the broth.
Saute julienned carrots with raisins until lightly caramelized.
Cook basmati rice in the reserved lamb broth with whole cumin and cardamom.
Layer the rice with lamb and the carrot-raisin mixture before serving.

items.heading: Mantu
details: Key ingredients: dumpling dough, ground beef, onion, yogurt, dried mint
Mix ground beef with finely chopped onion and spices for the filling.
Wrap small spoonfuls of filling in thin dumpling dough squares.
Steam the dumplings until the wrappers turn translucent.
Serve topped with garlicky yogurt and a tomato-based meat sauce.
